cmd: strings /app/vulnerable | grep -i flag; echo "---"; strings -t d /app/vulnerable | grep -i -E "flag|secret"
which objdump gdb python3 xxd hexdump radare2 r2 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; apt list --installed 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "binutils|gdb" | head
objdump -t /app/vulnerable | head -30; echo "==="; objdump -d -M intel /app/vulnerable > /app/disasm.txt; wc -l /app/disasm.txt

python3 - <<'EOF'
import struct
data = open('/app/vulnerable','rb').read()
# find virtual address 0x40405f in .data: parse ELF program headers
e_phoff = struct.unpack_from('<Q', data, 32)[0]
e_phentsize = struct.unpack_from('<H', data, 54)[0]
e_phnum = struct.unpack_from('<H', data, 56)[0]
for i in range(e_phnum):
    off = e_phoff + i*e_phentsize
    p_type, p_flags, p_offset, p_vaddr, p_paddr, p_filesz, p_memsz, p_align = struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQQQ', data, off)
    if p_type == 1 and p_vaddr <= 0x40405f < p_vaddr + p_filesz:
        file_off = p_offset + (0x40405f - p_vaddr)
        break
enc = data[file_off:]
out = bytearray()
for b in enc:
    if b == 0x42:
        break
    out.append(b ^ 0x42)
print("Static decryption:", out.decode())
EOF
rm -f /app/disasm.txt; ls -la /app; echo "=== results.txt content ==="; cat /app/results.txt; echo "=== hexdump ==="; od -c /app/results.txt
